name: tigergraph
description: Connect to any TigerGraph deployment — self-managed, on-premise, or a TigerGraph Savanna instance — using your host and credentials. Explore and evolve the graph schema, run GSQL and Cypher, load data from files and warehouses, and search vector embeddings.

tg_host.title: TigerGraph host
tg_host.description: Host URL of the TigerGraph instance, for example https://mycompany.i.tgcloud.io or http://localhost.

tg_password.title: Password
tg_password.description: Password for that account. Leave empty if you use an API token instead.

tg_graphname.title: Default graph
tg_graphname.description: Graph to use when a tool call does not name one. Optional.

tg_api_token.title: API token
tg_api_token.description: Optional alternative to the password. When set, it is used instead of the password.

tg_allowed_tools.title: Tools to offer
tg_allowed_tools.description: Narrow the 69 tools this server offers, so the agent carries less context on every request. Accepts categories (schema, data, query, vector, loading, utility, discovery), read-only, destructive, or tool names. Leave empty to offer all of them.
